description: Defines socket-related classes and functions for network communication, including Socket, SocketClient, SocketServer, and SocketSelect, with associated methods and member variables.

classes.name: Socket
classes.description: Base class for socket operations, managing socket file descriptor, connection details, and data transmission.

classes.name: SocketClient
classes.description: Derived class for client-side socket connections, supporting UDS and TCP connections.

classes.name: SocketServer
classes.description: Derived class for server-side socket operations, accepting incoming connections.

classes.name: SocketSelect
classes.description: Class for managing multiple sockets with select(), handling readiness and timeouts.

methods.name: getBytesReady
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes available to read.

methods.name: readBytes
methods.description: Reads bytes from the socket into a buffer.

methods.name: writeBytes
methods.description: Writes bytes from a buffer to the socket.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Sends a string message over the socket.

methods.name: setWriteTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for write operations.

methods.name: setReadTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for read operations.

methods.name: closeSocket
methods.description: Closes the socket connection.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the socket is open.

methods.name: getSocketFd
methods.description: Returns the socket file descriptor.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves the last error message.

methods.name: getPeerIP
methods.description: Returns the peer IP address.

methods.name: getPeerPort
methods.description: Returns the peer port number.

methods.name: getUdsPath
methods.description: Returns the UDS path.

methods.name: setPeerMac
methods.description: Sets the peer MAC address.

methods.name: getPeerMac
methods.description: Returns the peer MAC address.

methods.name: isAcceptedSocket
methods.description: Checks if the socket is an accepted connection.

methods.name: setIsServer
methods.description: Marks the socket as a server socket.

methods.name: acceptConnections
methods.description: Accepts incoming socket connections (SocketServer).

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for select() in SocketSelect.

methods.name: addSocket
methods.description: Adds a socket to the select set.

methods.name: removeSocket
methods.description: Removes a socket from the select set.

methods.name: clearReady
methods.description: Clears the ready state of a socket.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Returns the socket at a given index.

methods.name: selectSocket
methods.description: Performs the select() call to check socket readiness.

methods.name: readReady
methods.description: Checks if a socket is ready for reading.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of sockets managed.

methods.name: isBlocking
methods.description: Checks if the select is in blocking mode.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves and clears the last error message.
